These are pointwise negatives, not proof of universal inactivity.

A separately computed natural-log-signal cubic remains SAT_WITNESS against the paid responses under the stated deterministic-activation/shared-connected-band assumptions. A useful next prerequisite is a controlled cross-crystal test of whether the same residual activation response transfers across crystals; that premise remains conditional, not refuted. Reassess the model families after that matched transfer measurement or after resolving the incomplete coefficient search.
